description: Grade a domain's email security: SPF, DMARC, DKIM and MX score. $0.01 USDC on Base per call. Returns a 0-100 score and A-F grade (SPF 30, DMARC 40, DKIM 25, MX 5) from live DNS, with findings and the top 3 fixes. Bad input 400, unknown domain 404, not charged. Don't use this for the exact records to publish; use /v1/fix-plan. [x402: pays from the caller's wallet (X402_PRIVATE_KEY); without a key the tool returns the live 402 price only.]
